items.t: AppLovin vs. The Trade Desk: Which Is the Better Digital Advertising Stock to Buy Going Into 2027?
items.sum: AppLovin's AI-driven growth and fatter margins square off against The Trade Desk's cleaner balance sheet and open-web independence.
AppLovin fits an affordable growth screen: strong revenue/EPS growth, high profitability and health, with a fair valuation rather than a deep discount.

items.sum: AppLovin (APP) saw $16.7 million in net ETF selling on Wednesday.

items.t: AppLovin Just Ripped 47% in a Month: Is It Too Late to Buy APP Stock Now?
items.sum: AppLovin clawed back from a brutal slide with a blowout quarter and a fresh buyback, yet the stock still sits far below its peak. Bulls and bears read the same rally very differently, and a new legal cloud complicates the call.
AppLovin is slightly overvalued: DCF suggests shares trade 9% above base-case value after Q3 FY26 sales rose 55% and adjusted EBITDA grew 59%. Click for more on APP stock.

items.t: AppLovin (APP) Jumps On Strong Q3 Results, Is The Stock Still Cheap?
